theme.title: Five on the Floor
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: In the Warriors' record 73-win 2015–16 season, how many three-pointers did Stephen Curry make?
questions.context: Stephen Curry · Golden State · 2015–16 regular season
questions.note: 402 threes. Curry became the first NBA player to make 400 in one season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he finished with 402

funFacts.text: Golden State finished the regular season 73–9.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finishing with a record of 73–9

funFacts.text: Curry became the first player to make 400 threes in a season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first player in NBA history to hit 400 threes in a single season

funFacts.text: Curry averaged 30.1 points per game that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry finished the season averaging 30.1 points per game

questions.prompt: Boston scored 41 in the fourth quarter of Game 3 of the 2002 East finals. By how many points did it outscore New Jersey in that quarter?
questions.context: 2002 East finals · Game 3 · Celtics vs Nets
questions.note: By 25, 41–16, finishing a comeback from as many as 26 points down.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics outscored the Nets 41–16 in the fourth quarter
source.derivation: Boston 41 − New Jersey 16 = 25 points in the fourth quarter.

funFacts.text: Boston's historic Nets comeback began after the Celtics fell far behind in Game 3 of the East finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 3, the Celtics were down by as much as 26 points

funFacts.text: Kerry Kittles paced New Jersey's offense in the game Boston dramatically stole.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Kerry Kittles 19

funFacts.text: Paul Pierce was Boston's leading scorer in its playoff comeback against New Jersey.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Paul Pierce 28

questions.prompt: Kobe's 81 and the 70-point games of Booker and Luka are charted. How many did Kobe score in three quarters vs Dallas in December 2005?
questions.note: 62, one more than the whole Mavericks team had at that point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On December 20, 2005, Bryant scored 62 points in three quarters against the Dallas Mavericks

funFacts.text: Kobe had actually outscored the entire Dallas roster to that point, before the final quarter began.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: outscoring the Mavericks through three quarters by himself (62–61)

funFacts.text: Phil Jackson let Bryant sit out the last quarter because the game had become a rout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Phil Jackson allowed Kobe to rest in the fourth quarter because the game was a blowout.

funFacts.text: Jeanie Buss later said she was frustrated Kobe hadn't played the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jeanie Buss, Jackson's girlfriend, owner's Jerry Buss daughter, and Lakers vice president of player personnel, was self-admittedly mad at Jackson

questions.prompt: Chicago beat Utah by 42 in Game 3 of the 1998 Finals. By how many did Boston beat the Lakers in the 2008 title clincher?
questions.note: 39, 131–92, then the biggest margin in a title clincher; Boston also set a Finals record with 18 steals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 39-point margin of victory was the largest ever in an NBA championship-clinching game

funFacts.text: Ray Allen tied the then-Finals record for three-pointers made in Boston's title clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ray Allen hit seven three-pointers to tie what was then the Finals record

funFacts.text: Boston's defense set a Finals single-game steals record during the rout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: set a Finals record with 18 steals

funFacts.text: Every Celtics player who got on the court in the clincher scored at least once.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: every Boston player who saw action scored

questions.prompt: When Sacramento's 'Light the Beam' Kings finally made the 2023 playoffs, how many straight seasons had they missed?
questions.context: Sacramento Kings · 2023 return to the playoffs
questions.note: 16, then the NBA's longest active drought; Mike Brown was named Coach of the Year for ending it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: breaking a 16-year playoff drought, which at the time was the longest active playoff drought

funFacts.text: The beam became a homegrown celebration after Kings wins.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Kings began lighting a large, purple beam into the night sky after every game won

funFacts.text: Sacramento officially clinched its return with a win in Portland.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On March 29, the Kings beat the Portland Trail Blazers 120–80 to clinch a playoff spot

funFacts.text: Coach Mike Brown earned league Coach of the Year honors.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mike Brown was named NBA Coach Of The Year for his role in ending the playoff drought.
